steps.text: With the arm that had the catheter: don't lift, push or pull, don't bend or twist the wrist, and don't let anyone take your blood pressure on it.
No hard exercise with that arm, don't lift more than 5 pounds with it, and no baths, hot tubs or swimming. You can shower starting the day after your procedure.

note: Test data only. Not clinical guidance.

unmapped.text: For 48 hours and for 5 days after your procedure.
unmapped.reason: The sheet counts from the procedure, which isn't an anchor. Re-anchored to discharge. At least as restrictive: the window ends a few hours later than the sheet says, and between the procedure and discharge the patient is in hospital care.
